guides.first_step: Open the roadmap page and work the phases in order — story first, then strangers, then activities, then collectibles. The platinum unlocks the moment the other 54 are earned.
guides.watch_out: Nothing about the platinum itself is missable, but eight trophies below are one-time moments. Do them when they appear instead of leaving them for cleanup.

guides.first_step: Play the opening mission Gone Fishing from the start menu and follow its objectives to the end.
guides.watch_out: Unmissable story mission. It unlocks free roam and the rest of the trophy list.

guides.first_step: Play through every story mission in Chapter 1 until the chapter-end screen appears.
guides.watch_out: Story chapters cannot be missed — keep playing the gold mission markers and the trophy pops at the chapter close.

guides.first_step: Play through every story mission in Chapter 2 until the chapter-end screen appears.
guides.watch_out: Story chapters cannot be missed. Side content can wait — the chapter trophy only needs the story missions.

guides.first_step: Play through every story mission in Chapter 3 until the chapter-end screen appears.
guides.watch_out: Story chapters cannot be missed. If a mission fails, retry it from the checkpoint — progress is kept.

guides.first_step: Play through every story mission in Chapter 4 until the chapter-end screen appears.
guides.watch_out: Story chapters cannot be missed. Chapter 4 is the last full chapter before the finale.

guides.first_step: Finish the final story mission. Make a manual save before starting it so you can replay the finale freely.
guides.watch_out: Gold trophy. The finale is a single mission — there is no branching ending to replay for this trophy, just complete it.

guides.first_step: Play the story mission Breakfast Run when its marker appears and complete its objectives.
guides.watch_out: Unmissable story mission. It is part of the main story path, so it comes to you.

guides.first_step: Play the story mission The Cartel Heist when its marker appears and complete its objectives.
guides.watch_out: Unmissable story mission. Heist missions are long — expect several phases and a getaway.

guides.first_step: Play the story mission Child's Play when its marker appears and complete its objectives.
guides.watch_out: Unmissable story mission. It is part of the main story path.

guides.first_step: Play the story mission Headliners when its marker appears and complete its objectives.
guides.watch_out: Unmissable story mission. It is part of the main story path.

guides.first_step: Play the story mission VCIA Takedown when its marker appears and complete its objectives.
guides.watch_out: Unmissable story mission. This is the airport mission — it is also the area for the Catch Me If You Can trophy, so do that one while you are here if you can.

guides.first_step: Play the story mission Operation Savage Glory when its marker appears and complete its objectives.
guides.watch_out: Unmissable story mission. It is a late-story operation — expect heavy combat.

guides.first_step: After the finale, open the in-game 100% checklist and clear its categories one by one: story, strangers, activities, collectibles, exploration.
guides.watch_out: Gold trophy and the longest grind in the list. Track it on the roadmap page — the planner shows what is left. Nothing here is missable, just long.

guides.first_step: Start chaining stunts — jumps, near-misses, drifts — and keep a counter running. Any stunt counts toward the 250.
guides.watch_out: Silver trophy. Stunts only count when they register on screen, so chain them in open traffic and avoid crashing mid-stunt.

guides.first_step: Try one of each of the 9 activity types once: the activities page in the app lists them as you discover them.
guides.watch_out: Trying is enough — you do not need to win or complete any activity, just start each type once.

guides.first_step: Visit a Shooting Range and work through its 42 challenges, aiming for a gold medal in each.
guides.watch_out: Silver trophy. Gold medals are per-challenge, so you can retry a single challenge without redoing the rest.

guides.first_step: Find a Top Fun Drone Race and win it, then move to the next location — there are 14 in total.
guides.watch_out: You must win at every location, not just race at them. Learn each course's line before going for the win.

guides.first_step: Enter races across Leonida and win 20 different ones — a different race each time, not the same race 20 times.
guides.watch_out: Different races, so rotate events and locations. Wins in any race type count as long as the race itself is new to you.

guides.first_step: Take a fishing challenge against Cal and beat his score.
guides.watch_out: You only need to beat Cal once. If you lose, retry the challenge — losing does not lock you out.

guides.first_step: Walk into any arcade, pick one arcade game, and play it through to completion.
guides.watch_out: One completed arcade game is enough. Pick the shortest game on offer if you only want the trophy.

guides.first_step: Follow Andy's stranger strand to its last mission and complete it.
guides.watch_out: Stranger strands are chains — the final mission only appears after the earlier ones in the strand are done.

guides.first_step: Follow Kenton's stranger strand to its last mission and complete it.
guides.watch_out: Stranger strands are chains — the final mission only appears after the earlier ones in the strand are done.

guides.first_step: Follow Billy's stranger strand to its last mission and complete it.
guides.watch_out: Stranger strands are chains — the final mission only appears after the earlier ones in the strand are done.

guides.first_step: Complete 8 full stranger mission strands across Leonida — Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone are five of them, so find three more.
guides.watch_out: Silver trophy. A strand only counts when its final mission is done, so finish each chain you start.

guides.first_step: Follow Randy's stranger strand to its last mission and complete it.
guides.watch_out: Stranger strands are chains — the final mission only appears after the earlier ones in the strand are done.

guides.first_step: Follow Tyrone's stranger strand to its last mission and complete it.
guides.watch_out: Stranger strands are chains — the final mission only appears after the earlier ones in the strand are done.

guides.first_step: Find a meditation spot and meditate there, then move on to the next — there are 18 spots across Leonida.
guides.watch_out: Every spot counts, so use the map to sweep them in one route rather than hunting them one at a time.

guides.first_step: Talk to Bret, take the hunt, and track the unique animal he names.
guides.watch_out: The animal is unique — one specific animal, not any animal. Follow Bret's clues rather than hunting at random.

guides.first_step: Start collecting cards and finish 3 complete sets — trade or buy the ones you are missing.
guides.watch_out: Silver trophy. A set only counts when every card in it is collected, so track which sets are closest to done.

guides.first_step: Use WAiNK It at a location, then move on — repeat at 100 different locations across Leonida.
guides.watch_out: Silver trophy. Locations must be different, so spread out instead of repeating the same spot.

guides.first_step: Open the challenges list and work through them — any 50 completed challenges count.
guides.watch_out: Challenges span every activity, so this trophy fills itself in as you play. Check the list when you are close.

guides.first_step: While out with your partner, build a 4-star wanted level together, then lose the cops and escape while still together.
guides.missable_note: Needs a partner moment; do it when it appears.
guides.watch_out: MISSABLE (derived from the description, not play-verified): this needs your partner beside you during a police escape, which only happens in partner moments. Do it the first time the chance appears — do not leave it for cleanup.

guides.first_step: With your partner beside you, rob three shops in a row without losing your wanted level between them.
guides.missable_note: Three back-to-back partner robberies; one run only.
guides.watch_out: MISSABLE (derived from the description, not play-verified): the three robberies must be back-to-back with your partner present and the wanted level intact. Plan the route first, then run it in one go.

guides.first_step: Drive new vehicles you have never driven before — each first drive counts toward the 100.
guides.watch_out: Discovery is per vehicle model, so vary what you drive instead of sticking to one favourite.

guides.first_step: Enter Combat Focus with a group of enemies close together, then take down 5 of them before it ends.
guides.watch_out: All five must fall inside a single Combat Focus use. Pick a crowded fight and save it for when enemies bunch up.

guides.first_step: At VCIA airport, leave by an unscheduled departure — not the normal exit, an improvised way out.
guides.missable_note: Do it during the VCIA Takedown visit.
guides.watch_out: MISSABLE (derived from the description, not play-verified): the departure must be unscheduled, so do it while you are at the airport for the VCIA Takedown story mission rather than assuming you can come back and do it later.

guides.first_step: Find the Rhinos — the tanks — and deal with them in the encounter the description hints at.
guides.missable_note: Likely a one-time encounter; take it when it appears.
guides.watch_out: LIKELY MISSABLE (derived from the description, not play-verified): the description is a joke about tanks, which suggests a specific scripted encounter rather than a repeatable activity. Take the chance when it appears.

guides.first_step: Case a jewelry store, enter quietly, and rob it without any detection — no alarms, no witnesses.
guides.watch_out: Any detection fails the attempt, so go in quiet and leave before the alarm. If you are spotted, leave and try again.

guides.first_step: Rob a bank vault and escape, then repeat — five vaults in total.
guides.watch_out: Silver trophy. Each vault needs the robbery and the escape, so plan the getaway before you go in.

guides.first_step: Find an armored truck, rob it, and escape with the take.
guides.watch_out: One truck is enough. Hit it where the road is open so the getaway is clean.

guides.first_step: Travel across Leonida until all 52 areas register as explored — drive, fly and walk the map edges.
guides.watch_out: Areas only count when you actually enter them, so sweep the corners and islands, not just the cities.

guides.first_step: Rob one illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs — one per gang, not nine from the same gang.
guides.watch_out: Each gang needs its own hit. Track which gangs you have done so you do not repeat one by mistake.

guides.first_step: Go to Ocean Beach, order a cocktail, and enjoy the view.
guides.watch_out: A quiet moment, not a challenge — just be at the right place and order the drink.

guides.first_step: Get into a vehicle showroom and smash your way out in classic style.
guides.watch_out: The exit has to be a smash, not a walk — drive out through the front.

guides.first_step: Go to the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and bowl a full game to the end.
guides.watch_out: Follow-through matters — finish the game, do not quit halfway.

guides.first_step: Reach a partnership moment with mass appeal — a public moment with your partner that draws a crowd.
guides.missable_note: Likely a scripted story beat; do it when offered.
guides.watch_out: LIKELY MISSABLE (derived from the description, not play-verified): a partnership moment with mass appeal sounds like a scripted story beat, not a repeatable activity. Do it when the story offers it.

guides.first_step: Keep making choices as you play — the PSN counter tracks them up to 500, so choose often and keep choosing.
guides.missable_note: Choice counter to 500; choose whenever offered.
guides.watch_out: MISSABLE (derived from the description, not play-verified): the counter runs to 500 choices, and some choices only appear once. Make the choice whenever one is offered instead of walking past it.

guides.first_step: Fail something once, then succeed at it on the second try.
guides.missable_note: Fail once, succeed on the second try; do not reload.
guides.watch_out: LIKELY MISSABLE (derived from the description, not play-verified): second time's the charm only counts if the first attempt actually failed and the second succeeded, so do not reload a save to erase the failure.

guides.first_step: Keep your eyes open while exploring — the strange thing the description hints at happens once, in one place.
guides.missable_note: A one-time strange event; explore thoroughly.
guides.watch_out: LIKELY MISSABLE (derived from the description, not play-verified): a one-time strange event. Explore thoroughly and do not rush past odd scenes.

guides.first_step: While driving, hit someone with a melee attack from the vehicle — a melee drive-by.
guides.watch_out: The hit must be melee, not a gun, and it must be from a moving vehicle.

guides.first_step: Earn marked bills, then launder them through your contacts until $250,000 has gone through.
guides.watch_out: Only laundered money counts, so keep feeding marked bills to your contacts rather than spending them raw.

guides.first_step: Spend money across shops — clothes, food, gear — until $100,000 has gone through the tills.
guides.watch_out: Spending across all shops counts, so spread it around instead of buying one big item.

guides.first_step: Buy garage properties one by one until all 8 are yours.
guides.watch_out: All eight garages, so save up — they are a late-game purchase, not an early one.

guides.first_step: Register vehicles to the Scooter Bros app — ten different vehicles in total.
guides.watch_out: Each vehicle must be registered, not just driven. Use a mix of cars and bikes you own.

note: Expanded guides for the 55 official GTA VI trophies, written from the official descriptions (Exophase / PSNProfiles). GTA VI released 2026-11-19, so no guide here is play-verified yet — each entry says what the description asks for and what to do first, not a location we have stood in. Missable flags are derived from the descriptions and marked as such.
